claims.quote: Persistent hypotension can usually be treated with isotonic IV fluids (eg, 0.9% saline)

claims.text: Further inhaled bronchodilator: salbutamol (albuterol) and/or ipratropium; ⍉data favor one.
claims.quote: consider further inhaled bronchodilator therapy with salbutamol and/or ipratropium. There are no data to support the choice of one bronchodilator above another

claims.text: IV Mg sulfate ⍉recommended as a first-line IV bronchodilator: vasodilate can worsen hypotension.
claims.quote: Magnesium sulfate is not recommended as a first-line intravenous bronchodilator in anaphylaxis as it can cause significant vasodilation and worsen hypotension
